title: Lambda admissible subspaces of self adjoint matrices
summary: Given a self-adjoint matrix $A$ and an index $h$ such that $λ_h(A)$ lies in a cluster of eigenvalues of $A$, we introduce the novel class of $Λ$-admissible subspaces of $A$ of dimension $h$. First, we show that the low-rank approximation of the form $P_{\mathcal{T}} A P_{\mathcal{T}}$, for a subspace $\mathcal{T}$ that is close to any $Λ$-admissible subspace of $A$, has nice properties. Then, we prove that some well-known iterative algorithms (such as the Subspace Iteration Method, or the Krylov subspace method) produce subspaces that become arbitrarily close to $Λ$-admissible subspaces.
